subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Although the waters may have receded, __the aftermath of one of the world's biggest natural disaster __had only just begun.

options.text: the aftermath of one of the world's biggest natural disasters
the aftermath of one of the worlds' biggest natural disasters has
the aftermath of one of the worlds' biggest natural disaster

solution:
The correct answer is **the aftermath of one of the world's biggest natural disasters**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **one of** is a singular term and is generally used to talk about a noun or a pronoun (**natural disasters**).
 
• The **noun or a pronoun** used after the phrase “**one of**” is always in the **plural form** ( as we are talking of one person/place/thing out of many)
 
• **Natural disaster **should be replaced with **natural disasters **in the sentence to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence would be:
 
 
• *Although the waters may have receded, **the aftermath of one of the world's biggest natural disasters** __had only just begun.*

 
 
 

Hence, option 1 is the correct choice.
